metadata.description: Claude Code plugins and skills for the Go-native ecosystem — idiomatic Go development (golang-pro) and Temporal durable workflows.

plugins.name: temporal-developer
plugins.description: Develop, debug, and manage Temporal workflows across Python, TypeScript, Go, and Java. Covers durable execution, non-determinism, signals, queries, versioning, and AI/LLM patterns.

plugins.name: golang-pro
plugins.description: Go language development skills, agents, and commands. Covers idiomatic patterns, TDD, concurrency, gRPC, browser automation (Playwright, go-rod), and DBOS durable workflows.

plugins.name: nats
plugins.description: Develop with NATS messaging — core pub/sub, request/reply, queue groups, JetStream streams/consumers, key-value and object stores, security, clustering, leaf nodes, server deployment/embedding, the Services (micro) framework, and the NATS CLI.
